methods.digest: Input/source SHA hashes raw file bytes. OrderedJsonSha256 uses UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys; array order and encoded special numbers are retained.
methods.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n - 1) * q; >50 and >100 ms are strict. Empty/invalid measurements remain explicit.
methods.qualification: All failed/incomplete runs and phases remain. All raw callback adjacency, including censored boundaries, is retained separately from the named continuous subset. State anchors reset at recorded boundaries; censored spans and diagnostics remain, and any incomplete frame evidence prevents final integration qualification. No good-segment subset qualifies an incomplete phase.
methods.clocks: Callback entries and sampled new states use distinct child performance.now boundaries. Host pointer times and Node dispatch times remain separate; no host-minus-child or Node-minus-page latency.
methods.progress: Positively observed session-frame and presentation progress, not static repeated presentation. Gaps are between observable states and may span multiple underlying presentations.
methods.coverage: Owner/hook/getter checks are observed boundaries only. Cached original references or transient changes between checks are not ruled out. Ring loss/errors invalidate completeness globally; recorded internal discontinuities split state continuity and remain reported.
methods.scope: CDP-generated source through real Launcher/native properties; not a physical-finger delay, rAF request dispatch trace, single-tick CPU measurement, multiplayer rollback benchmark, no-hitch acceptance, or causal comparison across differently timed/frequency phases.
methods.instrumentation: Diagnostic wrappers, getters and snapshots add uncalibrated work; no performance improvement is inferred from these observations.
